E-01b

Accent system · HeyDoc + Partner

Used in scenes: 3–6 (any partner section)

Motiona partner section takes over the accent as its brand appears and hands back to HeyDoc blue when it ends; every hand-off blends over ~0.6s on the hue wheel.

State 1 · HeyDoc
#0873ba#139bf5#8fcdf8#eef7fd
One company brain.
State 2 · Partner — one brand hex in, every shade out

base = brand colour · deep = 20% toward black · light = +16 lightness (same hue) · pale = 62% toward white · line = 80% · tint = 90% · dot (unlit crowd) = 14% brand on grey · ink (text on white) = brand darkened in 5% steps until ≥ 3:1 contrast · on (text on a brand fill) = white if the brand passes 3:1, else navy · orb = radial deep → base → light · hand-offs between any two colours blend along the hue wheel. Film: CSS custom properties --partner1-*, --partner2-*; change one colour in brand.py or live in Edit mode → Partner brand colours.

E-02

The Pulse

Used in scenes: 1, 2, 6, 7, 11, 12 (recurring motif)

Motionpulse: 1.2s ease-out, ring scale 1 → 2.4, opacity .6 → 0, 3 rings staggered 400ms, loop. Glow fades in 300ms on fire. Links draw 600ms ease-in-out (stroke-dashoffset); packet travels the link in 1.2s.

E-03

Phone · iPhone replica + lock screen

Used in scenes: 1, 3, 5

Motionvector replica of the supplied iPhone mockup (all em units, scales with --phone-w). Notifications arrive one at a time, newest on top, 550ms spring; the clock never moves. Skeleton is the core → phone hand-off screen.

E-04

Chaos elements

Used in scenes: 1b

Motionwindows pop in staggered 80ms (scale .92 → 1, ease-spring) and settle at random ±3° tilt; notifications stack in 150ms each from top; queue dots fill left to right 40ms each, amber/red ones last.
